Electric Forest 2026: Why This is Unlike Any Other Festival

By PLURGASM @plurgasm ⏱ 3 min read

There is Electric Forest, and then there is every other festival. That sounds like hype, but ask anyone who has been and they will tell you the same thing. The forest changes people.

Electric Forest runs June 25–28, 2026 at Double JJ Resort in Rothbury, Michigan. It is a 4-day camping festival built around and inside Sherwood Forest, a real pine forest that the production team spends an entire year transforming into something that defies description.

Sherwood Forest: The Heart of It All

Sherwood Forest is not a stage. It is a 24-hour art installation: a winding network of paths through the trees, each one lit differently, filled with art pieces, secret stages, performers, and moments that happen nowhere else on earth.

You might turn a corner at 3AM and find a string quartet playing in a clearing. Or a fire performer. Or an entire crowd of people dancing to a DJ set underneath a canopy of lights strung through the trees. The forest runs all night and it is worth staying up for.

The 2026 Lineup

The headline acts for 2026 include ILLENIUM, GRiZ performing twice (a tradition at EF), and Subtronics. The booking that has everyone talking: Shaquille O'Neal B2B T-Pain in a DJ set that will absolutely be unhinged in the best possible way.

Electric Forest's strength is always the depth of the lineup, with bass music, jam bands, psychedelic electronic, house, and experimental acts filling 4 days across multiple stages. There is always something happening worth seeing.

Camping is Part of the Experience

Electric Forest is a camping festival in the truest sense. On-site camping is strongly recommended: the experience of waking up in the forest, walking to stages, and spending 4 full days in this environment is fundamentally different from commuting in each day.

General camping is included with GA Camping passes. Good Life (VIP) camping offers upgraded amenities. The campgrounds have showers, though lines get long, so shower at off-peak hours (early morning or late afternoon).

Practical Tips from Veterans

  • Bring a wagon. You will haul gear from your car to your campsite and a wagon makes it manageable. Many people rent them on-site.
  • Michigan weather is unpredictable. Pack a poncho and a layer. June can be beautiful and it can also rain hard for a full day.
  • Get lost in the forest. The scheduled FOMO is real but some of the best Electric Forest moments happen when you wander with no plan.
  • Bring lights for your campsite. String lights, LED stakes, anything to mark your tent so you can find it at 4AM.
  • The Good Life Lounge is worth it if you can afford it: AC, private bathrooms, and a shaded viewing area.

Tickets

GA Camping passes start around $399. Good Life (VIP) from $799. Day tickets are available at a lower price point if you cannot commit to all 4 days. Layaway is available. Electric Forest typically sells out well before the event, so do not wait.

If you can only go to one new festival this year, make it Electric Forest. It is the kind of experience that becomes a reference point, before and after.
